OpenStreetMap tiles are loaded only for the current online viewport.
No OSM tiles are downloaded or packaged with this archive.
Browser caching and Referer behaviour are left intact.
Tile policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/
Attribution: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
The local SVG fallback is the existing archive map, not an offline tile cache.
